title: A Sound in the Dark
lines: Meg sat up in bed one night.
She could hear a sound from near the shed.
It was a small sound, like a cry.
Meg felt fear. She held on to her bed.
Then she went to get her dad.
"Dad, I hear a sound," she said.
Dad said, "Stay near me in the dark, dear."
They went out with a lamp.
Meg went first. The sound got more clear.
It came from a box by the shed.
A small pup was stuck in that box.
Meg got it out. It licked her hand.
Meg has had that pup for a year now.

questions.ask: What was making the sound, and where was it?
questions.listenFor: A small pup, stuck in a box by the shed. It comes near the end, so let them look back.

questions.ask: Who went out into the dark with Meg?
questions.listenFor: Dad, with a lamp. He is the one who says stay near me, dear.

questions.ask: What would you have done if you heard that sound? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer works. Listen for a because, not for bravery.
